introduction.value: Reviewers had Muse send twice-daily eBay deal lists, flag a missed email, research a flight, and price an old camera bundle from eBay sales; it couldn't negotiate with a car dealer.

method.value: Reviewers used Meta's Muse, a cloud agent that browses, fills forms and connects to Gmail and similar services. Android Authority had it send a curated eBay deal list twice a day and scan Gmail. Moneywise asked it to research a New York to Tunis flight and price a camera bundle from eBay sales. It also asked for a used Jeep negotiation sheet.

outcome.value: It flagged a missed email, found flights at $462 to $725, and found eBay sales of $220 to $225 for a bundle a shop valued at $20. It couldn't negotiate with the dealer.

notes.value: The first eBay list included poor-condition items until the reviewer narrowed the instructions. He used about 6% of the weekly free allowance per day.

source_text.body:
Track eBay deals, research flights, and price used items
Reviewers had Muse send twice-daily eBay deal lists, flag a missed email, research a flight, and price an old camera bundle from eBay sales; it couldn't negotiate with a car dealer.
Done with
MM
Meta Muse
What they did
Reviewers used Meta's Muse, a cloud agent that browses, fills forms and connects to Gmail and similar services. Android Authority had it send a curated eBay deal list twice a day and scan Gmail. Moneywise asked it to research a New York to Tunis flight and price a camera bundle from eBay sales. It also asked for a used Jeep negotiation sheet.
How it went
It flagged a missed email, found flights at $462 to $725, and found eBay sales of $220 to $225 for a bundle a shop valued at $20. It couldn't negotiate with the dealer.
Worth knowing
The first eBay list included poor-condition items until the reviewer narrowed the instructions. He used about 6% of the weekly free allowance per day.
Try it yourself
with
Meta Muse
Copy prompt
Every day at [two times, e.g. 8am and 6pm], send me a list of the best new eBay deals for [item or search terms] under [price], with links and why each looks like a good deal. Also check my recent email for anything I may have missed from [sender or topic] and flag it. You're finished when the first deal list is in my inbox and you've told me what you flagged; ask before contacting any seller or buying anything.
Original source: https://askcompassplus.ai/blog/meta-muse-review
